title: Break calc↔context module cycle: extract EphemerisConfig/TopoPosition into leaf config.rs
description:
### Origin
Surfaced during vidhi-review of swisseph-rs/76+77. sutra flagged a **blocking** `no-module-cycles` violation: `src/calc.rs → src/context.rs` (provenance checkpoint swisseph-rs/8).

### Root cause
`EphemerisConfig` + `TopoPosition` are read-only config *data* but live in `context.rs` alongside the `Ephemeris` engine. calc.rs's ONLY dependency on context.rs is `use crate::context::EphemerisConfig`, while context.rs calls calc.rs heavily → cycle. Same config-import edge exists from 7 other computational modules (ayanamsa, deltat, sidereal_time, topocentric, riseset, eclipse).

### Fix
Extract `EphemerisConfig` + `TopoPosition` into a new **leaf** module `src/config.rs` (deps: `std::path`, `crate::flags`, `crate::types` only).

Wrinkle: `EphemerisConfig::set_sidereal_mode` reads the `AYANAMSA` table from `ayanamsa.rs`, and `ayanamsa.rs` imports `EphemerisConfig` — dragging the table into config.rs would just relocate the cycle. Instead, **move the `set_sidereal_mode` inherent-impl block from context.rs into ayanamsa.rs** (Rust permits inherent impls in any module of the same crate). Result: config.rs is a pure leaf, the AYANAMSA table stays home, and set_sidereal_mode sits next to the table it resolves.

Public API preserved via `pub use config::{EphemerisConfig, TopoPosition}` in lib.rs; `config.set_sidereal_mode(...)` still works.

### Files touched
- NEW `src/config.rs` (TopoPosition, EphemerisConfig struct + Default)
- `src/context.rs` (remove defs + set_sidereal_mode; import from config; drop now-unused imports)
- `src/ayanamsa.rs` (import EphemerisConfig from config; host set_sidereal_mode impl)
- `src/lib.rs` (add `pub mod config`; re-export split)
- Path swaps: calc.rs, sidereal_time.rs, topocentric.rs, deltat/mod.rs, riseset.rs, eclipse.rs

### Out of scope
The `Ephemeris`-passed-by-`&self` into riseset/eclipse creates context↔riseset / context↔eclipse cycles that sutra does NOT flag — that's the intentional stateless-engine design (per CLAUDE.md architecture), not touched here.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo build` clean (no warnings, esp. unused imports)
- `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean
- `cargo test` all pass
- `sutra_deps cycles=true` no longer reports `{calc, context}` blocking violation

### Convention violations (NOT actionable)
sutra also flagged 4 `complexity:med → kind:function` "violations" on `Ephemeris::{new, calc_with_config, rise_trans, calc_inner}`. These are FCA-miner noise: the rule learned "medium-complexity symbols are free functions" (92% of 61) and flags impl methods that are kind:method. Not fixable without turning methods into free functions. Left as-is.

acceptance_criteria.text: sutra no longer reports {calc,context} no-cycles blocking violation

decisions.decision: Move set_sidereal_mode inherent-impl block into ayanamsa.rs rather than dragging the AYANAMSA table into config.rs.
decisions.rationale: config.rs must be a pure leaf to break the cycle; set_sidereal_mode's dependency on the AYANAMSA table would pull ayanamsa into config.rs or relocate the cycle. Rust allows inherent impls in any same-crate module, so hosting set_sidereal_mode next to the AYANAMSA table it resolves keeps config.rs leaf-clean AND is more cohesive than its prior home in context.rs.
rejected_alternatives: Move AyaInit + AYANAMSA table into config.rs alongside EphemerisConfig (relocates domain data out of ayanamsa.rs and inverts ownership; ayanamsa computation would reach into config for its own table).
Move EphemerisConfig into types.rs instead of a new module (dumps a large config struct into the shared-types leaf; still needs the set_sidereal_mode relocation).

execution_record:
Executed as planned via a sonnet subagent (precise brief), independently verified by me. New src/config.rs leaf module holds EphemerisConfig + TopoPosition + Default; set_sidereal_mode inherent-impl relocated into ayanamsa.rs beside the AYANAMSA table (uses local AYANAMSA, not crate::ayanamsa::). Public API preserved via `pub use config::{EphemerisConfig, TopoPosition}` in lib.rs.

Verified: cargo build clean, cargo clippy --all-targets clean, 196 tests pass (83+12+101+0). calc.rs has zero crate::context refs. sutra_deps cycles=true → 0 cycles / 0 SCCs across the whole crate (was {calc,context}).

Deviations from plan (all reasonable): (1) context.rs KEPT SiderealBits + EphemerisSource imports — they're used by unrelated sidereal-transform code beyond the moved block, only genuinely-unused imports dropped. (2) 4 tests/golden/*.rs files (ayanamsa, ayanamsa_calc, deltat, sidereal_time) referenced the external path swisseph::context::EphemerisConfig — updated to swisseph::config, not in the original brief but required to compile --all-targets. (3) An edit-tool guard forced one read-only sutra_impact call on EphemerisConfig to unblock editing the load-bearing context.rs.

KNOWN ARTIFACT: sutra_constraints action=violations still lists the no-module-cycles constraint (id 22f0f35d) as a degenerate empty-path row (detail:'import cycle: ', from_path:'', to_path:'') after reparse, while sutra_deps correctly reports zero cycles. The constraints-violations endpoint appears to leave a stale constraint shell once the backing edge is gone. Not a live violation — sutra_deps is ground truth. Possible sutra reporting bug worth a look (Josh maintains sutra)." Files: NEW src/config.rs; src/context.rs, src/ayanamsa.rs, src/lib.rs; path swaps in calc.rs, sidereal_time.rs, topocentric.rs, deltat/mod.rs, riseset.rs, eclipse.rs, tests/golden/{ayanamsa,ayanamsa_calc,deltat,sidereal_time}.rs.

messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Pure code-motion refactor verified semantically identical (set_sidereal_mode logic line-for-line unchanged, EphemerisConfig/Default field-for-field unchanged). All 4 acceptance criteria independently re-verified: build 0 warnings, clippy --all-targets 0 warnings, 196/196 tests pass, sutra_deps reports 0 cycles crate-wide (blocking {calc,context} violation resolved). No sibling project references the removed swisseph::context::{EphemerisConfig,TopoPosition} module paths. Notes (low): (1) module-path imports of config types via `context::` are now breaking — crate-root re-exports preserved, all internal users updated, no external consumers found; (2) consider a doc breadcrumb on EphemerisConfig noting set_sidereal_mode's impl lives in ayanamsa.rs next to the AYANAMSA table.
